An '''Executor''' was a position in the [[Jedi Covenant]] faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] active in the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. While not a seer like most of the other members of the Covenant, the Executor was responsible for handling arrangements and providing practical help and protection. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] was the Executor for the Covenant's [[First WatchCircle]].
